title: Quit (Keep Sessions) while the daemon is an older build's, reopen this build: the daemon hands off, and every workspace, pane, terminal and its scrollback comes back
why: Lawrence 2026-11-01 lost all workspaces and terminals at a reopen right after cmux-ad launched a NEW dogfood build: the reopen saw a daemon of another build_commit, so DaemonLauncher.handOffIfStale sent shutdown-daemon (STATUS 2718, lead 01:1xZ). A handoff must keep every terminal host and the workspace registry. Set-up: End Everything, reopen with CMUX_NEXT_TUI_BIN = the prior build's cmux-tui (an owner of another build), make the work, then a REAL Cmd-Q and a reopen with no override, as a Dock click after an update.

set-up: the daemon is the prior build's (else not run)
400 numbered lines, the last on screen
set-up: three more workspaces, a terminal each
what must come back: daemon pid, holder and hosts, workspaces, terminals, panes

steps.title: a REAL Cmd-Q; the dialog's default (Keep) is pressed; reopen with NO override, as after an update: the daemon hands off
the reopen handed the daemon off; the holder and every host still run; every workspace and terminal is back and live

the real Cmd-Q asked how to quit: Keep Sessions (default), End Sessions, End Everything, Cancel
